name: Shadow Form (Sp)
body:
Prerequisite: Nightblade 9

Benefit: The nightblade can turn herself into a natural shadow, as the spell shadow form, for a number of minutes per day equal to half her nightblade level. This duration does not have to be consecutive, but must be spent in 1-minute increments.
